blocks.text: Doppler effect electromagnetic waves par bhi lagu hota hai. Is ka ek aham istemal radar system hai, jo radio waves se hawai jahaz ki oonchai (elevation) aur speed maloom karta hai. RADAR (RAdio Detection And Ranging) ek aala hai jo radio waves bhejta aur wapas wasool karta hai. Agar jahaz radar ki taraf aa raha ho to jahaz se reflect hone wali wave ki wavelength chhoti hogi, aur agar door ja raha ho to wavelength lambi hogi, jaisa Fig. 7.13 (a) aur (b) mein hai. Isi usool se Zameen ke gird ghoomne wale satellites ki speed bhi maloom ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse, baen taraf radar dish aur daen taraf hawai jahaz. Radar surmai lehrein bhejta hai. (a) Jahaz radar ki taraf aata hai aur us ki goonj (echo) dabi hui lehron ke saath, zyada frequency par lauti hai. (b) Jahaz door jata hai aur goonj ki lehrein khinchi hui, kam frequency.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.13: Radar mein frequency ka shift hawai jahaz ki harkat pakarne ke liye istemal hota hai: (a) qareeb aata jahaz, (b) door jata jahaz (kitab ki Figure 7.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: SONAR "Sound Navigation And Ranging" ka mukhtasar naam (acronym) hai. Yeh pani ke neeche sonic ya ultrasonic awaz ki goonj (echo) se faasla aur gehrai naapne wale system ka aam naam hai. Sonar ek technique hai jis se pani ke neeche cheezon ki maujoodgi awaz ki goonj se maloom ki jati hai. Sonar mein "Doppler detection" target aur detector ki relative speed par depend karta hai aur target ki speed batata hai. Is mein Doppler effect istemal hota hai: jab source aur observer ek doosre ke nisbat harkat mein hon to frequency mein zahiri tabdeeli hoti hai. Is ke fauji istemal: submarines ka pata lagana aur un ki jagah maloom karna, antisubmarine hathiyaron ka control, mines dhoondna aur samandar ki gehrai naapna.

Astronomy mein astronomers door ke sitaron aur galaxies ki speed Doppler effect se nikalte hain. Sitare ki roshni ke line spectrum ko laboratory source ki roshni se mila kar sitare ki roshni ka Doppler shift naapa jata hai, aur phir sitare ki speed nikali jati hai.

items: (i) Zameen se door jane wale sitare red shift dikhate hain (Fig. 7.14 b). Un ki nikli hui waves ki wavelength us se lambi hoti hai jo sitare ke aaram mein hone par hoti. Is liye spectrum lambi wavelength, yani spectrum ke red (laal) sire, ki taraf khisak jata hai. Astronomers ne yeh bhi maloom kiya hai ke tamam door ki galaxies hum se door ja rahi hain, aur un ke red shift naap kar un ki speed ka andaza lagaya hai.

(ii) Zameen ki taraf aane wale sitare blue shift dikhate hain (Fig. 7.14 c), kyunke un ki roshni ki wavelength us se chhoti hoti hai jo sitare ke aaram mein hone par hoti. Is liye spectrum chhoti wavelength, yani blue (neele) sire, ki taraf khisak jata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qataren, har ek mein sitara lehar bhejta hai aur spectrum baen laal se daen jamni tak, jis par ek kaali lakeer. (a) Thehra sitara, aam lehar, lakeer apni asal jagah; Zameen ka nishan. (b) Door jata sitara, khinchi lehar, lakeer laal ki taraf. (c) Qareeb aata sitara, dabi lehar, lakeer neele ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.14: (a) thehra sitara, (b) door jata sitara, (c) qareeb aata sitara (kitab ki Figure 7.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kaali lakeer kisi element ki pehchan hai. Sitara door jaye to lehar khinchti hai (lambi wavelength) aur lakeer laal ki taraf khisakti hai: red shift. Qareeb aaye to lehar dabti hai aur lakeer neele ki taraf: blue shift. Kitab ke (a) mein yeh lakeer nazar nahi aati; muqable ke liye yahan (a) mein lakeer ki asal jagah dikhayi gayi hai.

Electromagnetic waves ke Doppler shift ka ek aur aham istemal radar speed trap hai. Transmitter se microwaves chhote chhote jhatkon (bursts) mein bheji jati hain. Har burst raaste mein aane wali kisi gaari se reflect ho jata hai, aur do bursts ke darmiyan transmitter reflected microwaves pakarne ke liye khula rehta hai. Agar reflection kisi chalti cheez se ho to reflected microwaves Doppler shifted hoti hain. Doppler shift naap kar computer programme gaari ki speed nikal leta hai.
Satellite navigation Doppler shift se satellite ki velocity aur position maloom karti hai, jis se location theek theek track hoti hai.
Satellite communication bhi Doppler shift ki compensation (talafi) karti hai taake communication signals mustaqil rahein.
Doppler radar hawa ki velocity aur barish (precipitation) ke patterns pakarta hai. Doppler shift Zameen ki satah ki velocity aur deformation (bigaar) naapne mein bhi madad deta hai.

Doppler echocardiography khoon ke bahao (blood flow) ki velocity naapti hai aur dil ki kharabiyan pakarti hai, jaise valve ka tang hona (stenosis) ya khoon ka ulta bahao (regurgitation). Yeh pacemaker ki settings behtar karne mein bhi kaam aati hai.

Doppler ultrasound khoon ka bahao naapta hai aur cardiac output (dil se nikalne wala khoon fi minute) nikalta hai. Yeh khoon ki naliyon ka tang hona (stenosis) ya band hona (occlusion) bhi pakarta hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.12
blocks.problem: Ek dhundli galaxy ke absorption spectrum ki ek line, jise Ca-α line pehchana gaya, ki wavelength 478 nm payi gayi. Laboratory mein isi line ki wavelength 397 nm naapi gayi. (a) Kya galaxy Zameen ki taraf aa rahi hai ya door ja rahi hai? (b) Zameen ke nisbat galaxy ki speed nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: laboratory wavelength λ = 397 nm = 397 × 10⁻⁹ m, apparent wavelength λ′ = 478 nm = 478 × 10⁻⁹ m, roshni ki speed c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹.
(a) c = fλ se f = c/λ = (3 × 10⁸)/(397 × 10⁻⁹) = 7.56 × 10¹⁴ Hz (laboratory frequency).
λ′ > λ, yani f′ < f: wavelength lambi ho gayi (red shift), is liye galaxy Zameen se door ja rahi hai.
(b) Door jate source ka formula, v ki jagah c: f′ = (c/(c + uₛ)) f.
blocks.answer: (a) Galaxy door ja rahi hai. (b) uₛ = 6.12 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ (roshni ki speed ka taqreeban 20%).

blocks.title: Galactic Motion
blocks.text: Ek galaxy hum se roshni ki speed ke 20% (yani 0.2 c) se door ja rahi hai. Is galaxy se aane wali ek spectral line hum dekhte hain jo aam taur par 500 nm wavelength par nikalti hai. (Sawal: yeh kis wavelength par nazar aayegi? Jawab neeche self-check mein.)

blocks.prompt: Insanon mein dil ke masail parhne ke liye Doppler effect kaise istemal hota hai (short question 7.6)? Galactic Motion box: ek galaxy 0.2 c se door ja rahi hai; jo spectral line aam taur par 500 nm par nikalti hai woh kitni wavelength par nazar aayegi (kitab ka formula istemal karein)?
blocks.explanation: Ultrasound dil aur khoon ki naliyon mein bheja jata hai; chalte hue red blood cells (khoon ke surkh khaliye) use reflect karte hain aur woh Doppler shifted ho kar wapas aata hai. Shift se khoon ke bahao ki speed aur simt maloom hoti hai, is liye tang (stenosis) ya ulta bahao (regurgitation) wale valves, band naliyan aur cardiac output naape ja sakte hain. Galaxy: kitab ke formula f′ = (c/(c + uₛ)) f aur λ = c/f se λ′ = λ (c + uₛ)/c = 500 × 1.2 = 600 nm, yani 100 nm ka red shift.

items: Doppler effect electromagnetic waves par bhi lagu hai: radar (jahaz aur satellites ki speed), sonar (pani ke neeche).
Astronomy: door jane wale sitare red shift, qareeb aane wale blue shift; tamam door ki galaxies hum se door ja rahi hain.
Doosre istemal: radar speed trap, satellite navigation aur communication, Doppler radar (mausam), echocardiography aur Doppler ultrasound.
Example 7.12: 397 nm ki line 478 nm par, f′ < f, galaxy 6.12 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹ se door ja rahi hai.
